newsitem.title: ISRAEL: UBS said considering TASE membership.
newsitem.headline: UBS said considering TASE membership.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) recently asked the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE) to check the possibility of it becoming a full member of the bourse, Israel's Haaretz newspaper said on Thursday.
Currently there are no foreign members on the Tel Aviv exchange.
"We don't confirm or deny anything that is related to our business plans so I have nothing to say," Daniel Carasso, UBS representative in Israel, told Reuters.
A TASE spokeswoman said the bourse never commented on such reports.
Haaretz quoted an unnamed UBS "manager" in London as saying of the report: "It is still too early to talk about the subject, a decision has yet to be taken."
UBS officials in London were not immediately available to comment.
Haaretz said the TASE had decided to change some procedures to allow quick acceptance of UBS as a full member of the exchange.

It said UBS, among the largest foreign players in Israel, was expected to open an office in Israel soon and the first step was its request for TASE membership to enable it to act directly on behalf of its clients.
